entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hello, Diana. I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I have a ClubFit Jersey that I need to return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a ride yesterday and it's just way too tight. I was hoping to do an exchange for a larger size.
Okay, I understand. A jersey that's too tight is definitely no good for a comfortable ride. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the ClubFit Jersey. It looks like it was delivered 82 days ago.
Right, I know it's been a while. Is that going to be a problem?
Not at all. I'm just checking our policy here... and yes, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you.

That's great news, I appreciate that. Now, since I'm going through the hassle of shipping this back and placing a new order for the exchange, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase? I've been a VIP member for a few years now.
Of course, and we really appreciate your loyalty. Since you're a VIP customer, I can definitely add a 15% discount coupon to your account. It will be automatically applied to your next order.
Perfect, that's exactly what I was hoping for. Thank you, Diana, you've been very helpful.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return for the jersey and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the item. The 15% discount is active on your account starting now. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride!
